title: Bootstrapping through an intermediate model
description: Do not train the strong student on the weak labels directly. First train an intermediate model on them, here a linear probe on the student's frozen backbone, which has too little capacity to memorize label noise. Then relabel the training data with the intermediate model's predictions and fine-tune the full student on those. Prediction: the student copies fewer of the weak supervisor's errors and recovers more of the gap.

source.title: Weak-to-strong generalization: eliciting strong capabilities with weak supervision
source.authors: Burns, Izmailov, Kirchner, Baker, Gao, Aschenbrenner, Chen, Ecoffet, Joglekar, Leike, Sutskever, Wu
